name: Yunnan Jinxun Resources Co., Ltd.
summary: Yunnan Jinxun Resources Co., Ltd. engages in the mineral processing, smelting, and trading of non-ferrous metals in Chinese Mainland, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Zambia, and Peru. The company operates through two segments, Metal Production and Processing, and Trading Business. The company engages in the smelting, processing, and sale of cathode copper, cobalt, and copper concentrate; mining trading business; and manufacturing, processing, and sale of cobalt related materials. It also provides cobalt hydroxide, sulfate, and chloride. Yunnan Jinxun Resources Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Kunming, China.
